title: MoG-VLM: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection through Motion-Guided Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31478v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection, but dense frame-level inference makes them impractical for real-time deployment. Existing acceleration commonly relies on uniform sampling, which ignores content dynamics and can either waste computation on static segments or miss localized anomalies. We propose MoG-VLM a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that leverages motion purely as a lightweight control signal to decide when VLM inference is necessary. To this end, we introduce Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) which performs content-aware sampling to concentrate computation on informative regions while avoiding redundant processing. We further introduce a hierarchical dual-stream design in which dense multi-frame VLM reasoning is activated only around frames with elevated anomaly likelihood, via anchor-triggered context-window expansion with early termination. translated_title: MoG-VLM：通过运动引导的视觉语言模型实现高效视频异常检测
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在视频异常检测方面展现出强大潜力，但密集的帧级推理使其难以实现实时部署。现有的加速方法通常依赖均匀采样，这种方式忽略了内容的动态变化，可能将计算浪费在静态片段上，或遗漏局部化的异常。我们提出MoG-VLM，一种运动自适应的异常检测框架，它将运动纯粹用作轻量级控制信号，以决定何时需要进行VLM推理。为此，我们引入了时间梯度幅度（TGM），用于执行内容感知采样，将计算集中在信息丰富的区域，同时避免冗余处理。我们进一步引入了分层双流设计，其中密集的多帧VLM推理仅在异常可能性升高的帧附近被激活，通过锚点触发的上下文窗口扩展及提前终止机制实现。融合模块随后…（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MoG-VLM框架，将时间梯度幅度（TGM）作为轻量级运动控制信号进行内容感知采样，并仅在高异常可能性的帧附近激活密集的多帧VLM推理，从而在保持检测精度的同时显著提升视频异常检测的实时效率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MoG-VLM, which uses Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) as a lightweight motion control signal for content-aware sampling and activates dense multi-frame VLM reasoning only around high anomaly-likelihood frames, enabling efficient and real-time video anomaly detection.
